title: Summary of The Gottman Doctors: Affairs Can Save Your Relationship! But If You See This, Walk Away!

segments.text: if you're struggling with the aftermath of an affair this episode of the Diary of a CEO with the renowned gotman doctors might just change your perspective can infidelity truly save a relationship
doctors John and Julie gotman believe it can if you see the signs of recovery
but what about when you should walk away they explore the complexities of rebuilding trust how to recognize when a relationship is beyond repair and what science says about emotional healing
tune in for a profound conversation that just might reh shape how you think about betrayal love and commitment
here are five actionable insights from the episode
atonement is key
when addressing an affair the betraying partner must show genuine remorse
and apologize
repeatedly
this helps ease the hurt partner's pain as forgiveness alone won't work without sincere
atonement
identify patterns in Conflict
many Affairs stem from loneliness and conflict avoidance
couples need to break the cycle of emotional Distance by addressing issues directly rather than seeking Comfort outside the relationship
rebuild trust
gradually
trust can only be restored over time starting with transparency
betrayers must openly answer questions but avoid detailing sexual aspects as this can intensify the trauma for the Betrayed partner
recognize
when it's over
not all relationships can be saved if the Rel relationship feels like ashes and there's no spark left it might be time to move on rather than trying to reignite a flame that no longer
exists
understand the phases of healing
recovering from an affair involves three stages
atonement
atunement and attachment
focus on addressing the past wounds before attempting to reconnect emotionally and sexually
in this episode The renowned gotman doctors John and Julie gotman explore the complex an often controversial topic of infidelity and its effects on relationships
boldly stating that Affairs can save your relationship
they argue that while infidelity can be devastating
it does not always spell the end of a relationship

in fact with the right therapeutic intervention couples can not only recover from an affair but sometimes use it as an opportunity to rebuild trust and create a stronger more connected partnership than before the Gans emphasize that the majority of Affairs about 75%
can be healed if the couple seeks professional help they explain that affairs often arise from deeper issues like emotional disconnection and loneliness
rather than simply being about sex
couples who avoid conflict and emotional intimacy are more susceptible to infidelity
as one partner May seek outside connection when they feel unheard or unloved in the relationship

the episode outlines the atonement Attunement attachment model the gans's developed to help couples navigate the aftermath of infidelity and work toward healing in the atonement phase the partner who had the affair must take full responsibility for their actions and be fully transparent with their betrayed partner this phase also involves repeated apologies and an acknowledgement that the trauma
caused by infidelity
can have longlasting effects
the Attunement phase focuses on addressing the root causes of the affair including long-standing issues like emotional avoidance and patterns of criticism
finally the the attachment phase is about rebuilding physical and emotional intimacy
often after the couple has done significant emotional work
the Gans also discuss when it's time to walk away from a relationship
particularly when toxic behaviors
such as contempt the most corrosive dynamic in a relationship
become pervasive
when contempt criticism
defensiveness
and stonewalling
The gottman's Four Horsemen of relationship breakdown
dominate interactions
it becomes much harder for a relationship to recover unless both partners are committed to change
the episode stresses that emotional intimacy trust and connection are the true foundations of a healthy relationship
including a satisfying sex life while Affairs can sometimes act as a wakeup call to address long ignored issues
they caution that the healing process is long and complex
requiring both Partners to be fully engaged in repairing the relationship ship
